feature: OPTIONAL MATCH — left-outer-join semantics over a single optional hop

scenarios.name: OPTIONAL MATCH keeps zero-match rows — COUNT is 0, not absent
scenarios.query: MATCH (t:pg_node) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)<-[:PG_OPTIONAL]-(g:pg_node) RETURN t.entity_id AS target, COUNT(g) AS guards ORDER BY target

scenarios.name: a plain MATCH of the same shape drops the zero-match rows
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match (plain MATCH drops zero-match rows)
scenarios.query: MATCH (t:pg_node)<-[:PG_OPTIONAL]-(g:pg_node) RETURN t.entity_id AS target, COUNT(g) AS guards ORDER BY target

scenarios.name: OPTIONAL MATCH along an outbound edge counts the fan-out
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match (optional outbound edge fan-out)
scenarios.query: MATCH (h:pg_hub) OPTIONAL MATCH (h)-[:PG_LINKS]->(t:pg_node) RETURN h.entity_id AS hub, COUNT(t) AS links

scenarios.name: OPTIONAL MATCH scoreboard composes with ORDER BY and LIMIT
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match (optional match with ORDER BY + LIMIT)
scenarios.query: MATCH (t:pg_node) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)<-[:PG_OPTIONAL]-(g:pg_node) RETURN t.entity_id AS target, COUNT(g) AS guards ORDER BY guards DESC LIMIT 1

scenarios.name: WHERE on the optional variable constrains the join — it does not drop rows
scenarios.query: MATCH (t:pg_node) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)<-[:PG_OPTIONAL]-(g:pg_node) WHERE g.data.severity_score > 100 RETURN t.entity_id AS target, COUNT(g) AS guards ORDER BY target

scenarios.name: WHERE on the mandatory variable filters the outer scan
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match (WHERE on the mandatory variable)
scenarios.query: MATCH (t:pg_node) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)<-[:PG_OPTIONAL]-(g:pg_node) WHERE t.data.kind = "target" RETURN t.entity_id AS target, COUNT(g) AS guards ORDER BY target

scenarios.name: COUNT of the optional edge variable counts matching optional edges
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — clauses/match (COUNT over optional edge, null not counted)
scenarios.query: MATCH (t:pg_node) OPTIONAL MATCH (t)<-[e:PG_OPTIONAL]-(g:pg_node) RETURN t.entity_id AS target, COUNT(e) AS guard_edges ORDER BY target
